title: ChatResponse
$comment: Role: the canonical non-streaming chat result (docs/architecture.md §3.1; ocai/chat/types/response.py ChatResponse) in omit-absent wire form — the shape `chat.response` payload the conversion graph decodes from a provider node to the canonical node, and the value StreamAccumulator.fold must reproduce (the fold law, compared with the raw lane excluded per spec/canonical-json.md §8). A pure graph payload: NO report member — the FidelityReport lives on CallResult.report and only there. Single message forever: decoded provider choices[1:] land in a censused extension with reported loss, never in this shape.
description: A provider-neutral chat result: the model's reply turn, why generation stopped, what the call consumed, the provider anchors identifying the response, and the untouched provider body for power users.

usage.description: What the call consumed, when reported.

info.description: The response's provider anchors, when reported.

raw.description: The provider's untouched response body, for power users — a verbatim provider lane, deliberately unconstrained (any JSON value). Excluded from semantic equality and fold-fixture comparison (spec/canonical-json.md §8); never contains credentials.

responseInfo.$comment: ocai/chat/types/response.py ResponseInfo — the provider anchors identifying one response.

id.description: The response's provider-side identity (kind "response_id"), directly reusable as a follow-up anchor on interfaces with server-side threads; crossing another (provider, interface) is reported UNSUPPORTED.

model.description: The provider's echo of the model that actually served the call (which may be more specific than the requested alias).

created.description: When the provider says the response was created, as an ISO-8601 timestamp.
